plans.name: Workshop Repo Scope
plans.overview: Define the repository boundaries, domain anonymization rules, TypeScript-only constraint, and the exact AI testing capabilities the workshop repository will cover.

todos.content: Define the repository mission as a practical Evalite workshop for QA testers focused only on AI output evaluation.
Lock the implementation stack to strict TypeScript and reject non-TypeScript lab implementations.
Define the three anonymized capability areas: translations, mobile search intent extraction, and travel information summary.
Define the no-sensitive-data policy for examples, fixtures, prompts, generated outputs, and documentation.
Define the participant skill level assumptions so labs require running commands and editing small datasets, not application programming.

plans.name: Runtime Tooling
plans.overview: Prepare the TypeScript runtime, Evalite beta dependency, package scripts, Mise and Proto configuration, Docker fallback, and environment model so every participant can run the labs.

todos.content: Create package metadata with strict TypeScript, ESM, pnpm, tsx, zod, vitest, and evalite beta dependencies.
Add TypeScript configuration with strict settings and predictable module resolution for Evalite lab files.
Add Proto and Mise configuration with pinned Node and pnpm versions plus one-command setup and verification tasks.
Add Dockerfile and compose service that can install dependencies and run all mock-mode verification without host tooling.
Add environment configuration for mock mode by default and optional live model or live judge mode through explicit env variables.
Add stable package scripts for smoke, dataset validation, individual labs, all evals, and result export.

plans.name: Domain Fixtures And Datasets
plans.overview: Design anonymized JSONL datasets and validation schemas for translation, mobile search, summary, prompt injection, and consistency labs.

todos.content: Define shared dataset metadata fields for source, capability, risk, labels, expected behavior, and anonymization status.
Create JSONL schema and loader utilities for typed dataset records.
Prepare translation datasets covering basic quality, placeholders, tags, product-like codes, and terminology consistency.
Prepare mobile search datasets covering single-turn intent extraction, ambiguous inputs, missing fields, and conversation history.
Prepare travel information summary datasets covering required facts, unsupported claims, warnings, and insufficient source text.
Prepare prompt injection and consistency datasets using anonymized, shareable attack and paraphrase examples.
Add dataset quality fixtures that intentionally contain fixable issues for the first lab.

plans.name: Capability Mocks
plans.overview: Build small TypeScript mock AI capabilities that simulate translations, mobile search intent extraction, and travel information summary so all labs run without external API access.

todos.content: Define shared capability input and output types for all app simulators.
Implement translation capability variants with baseline, flawed, and improved behavior.
Implement mobile search capability variants that return structured intent objects and follow-up questions.
Implement travel information summary capability variants that summarize only supplied text and expose controlled failure modes.
Add prompt and model variant registry so labs can compare behavior without changing eval files.
Add optional live provider seam guarded by env variables while keeping mock mode the default.

plans.name: Scorer Library
plans.overview: Implement reusable deterministic scorers, structured-output scorers, safety scorers, consistency scorers, and judge scorers for the workshop labs.

todos.content: Implement text guardrail scorers for placeholders, tags, forbidden phrases, length ratio, glossary terms, and output language heuristics.
Implement structured-output scorers for schema validity, field accuracy, missing-field behavior, and intent classification.
Implement summary scorers for required facts, unsupported claims, contradiction markers, warning coverage, and refusal correctness.
Implement safety scorers for instruction override, system prompt leakage, schema bypass, and secret-like output.
Implement consistency scorers for paraphrase equivalence, repeated-run variance, and regression counts.
Implement mock judge and optional live judge scorer with rubric dimensions and calibration metadata.

plans.name: Evalite Labs
plans.overview: Create at least six hands-on Evalite lab files that exercise dataset quality, translation evaluation, mobile search intent testing, variant comparison, summary evaluation, judge calibration, prompt injection, and consistency regression.

todos.content: Create Lab 1 for dataset quality checks over intentionally flawed JSONL records.
Create Lab 2 for deterministic translation guardrail evaluation.
Create Lab 3 for translation quality evaluation with rubric-backed judge scoring.
Create Lab 4 for mobile search single-turn intent extraction and structured output scoring.
Create Lab 5 for mobile search conversation history, missing details, changed intent, and follow-up behavior.
Create Lab 6 for prompt and model variant comparison using Evalite beta patterns.
Create Lab 7 for travel information summary evaluation against supplied source text and expected facts.
Create Lab 8 for judge calibration using known good, bad, and borderline examples.
Create Lab 9 for prompt injection and data leakage regression checks.
Create Lab 10 for consistency, paraphrase stability, repeated-run variance, thresholds, and result export.

plans.name: Participant Docs
plans.overview: Write concise participant-facing setup and lab instructions that explain commands, expected edits, and troubleshooting without exposing checkpoint branch names.

todos.content: Create README with workshop purpose, prerequisites, supported setup paths, and first verification command.
Create setup documentation for Mise, Proto, direct pnpm, and Docker paths.
Create one short lab handout per Evalite lab with goal, files to inspect, command to run, and participant task.
Create troubleshooting guide for dependency install, Docker, Evalite UI, port conflicts, and missing optional API keys.
Review all docs to remove checkpoint branch references and any sensitive or customer-identifying language.

plans.name: Facilitator Runbook
plans.overview: Prepare instructor-only guidance for lab sequencing, expected failures, discussion prompts, rescue procedures, and branch-based checkpoints.

todos.content: Document the intended learning point and expected failure mode for each lab.
Document instructor-only rescue steps using checkpoint branches without copying those branch names into participant materials.
Document optional deeper discussion prompts for dataset design, scorer reliability, judge calibration, and release gating.
Document how to switch between mock mode and optional live model mode during facilitation.
Document pre-workshop dry-run checklist and last-minute environment checks.

plans.name: Checkpoint Branches
plans.overview: Create instructor-only git checkpoint branches for each stable workshop state so participants can be rescued without exposing the mechanism in materials.

todos.content: Initialize git repository state and define checkpoint branch naming convention for instructor-only use.
Create runtime-ready checkpoint after tooling, install, smoke, and Docker verification pass.
Create lab checkpoints after each lab reaches a runnable and independently verifiable state.
Create final polished checkpoint with all labs, docs, runbook, and verification complete.
Verify no participant-facing material references checkpoint branch names or internal rescue procedures.

plans.name: Verification
plans.overview: Verify the repository from clean local and Docker paths, with and without optional live model credentials, and ensure no sensitive or out-of-scope content has entered the workshop.

todos.content: Verify fresh local setup using the primary Mise and Proto path.
Verify Docker setup from a clean checkout without host node_modules.
Verify every lab command in mock mode.
Verify optional live judge or live model mode separately without making it required.
Verify dataset validation, TypeScript typecheck, smoke tests, Evalite runs, and result export.
Scan repository content for sensitive data, customer-identifying strings, checkpoint leakage in participant docs, and unrelated topics.
